impact: CI run 35045137495 failed on GitHub Actions: term_level_refusal_gate::a_copy_rows_own_visible_no_reaches_the_converted_rule panicked with 'the pinned tree carries .COPY= rows stating VISIBLE:NO; this gate proved nothing', because CI never fetches the pinned PCGen oracle checkout and corpus_root() reads with unwrap_or_default(), leaving hidden_copies at 0
resolution: Added the same absent-checkout guard already used by src/pcgen_import/cache_gen/*.rs: eprintln a skip line and return when pinned.join(closure::BOOKS_RELATIVE) is not a directory, before the gate's body runs
summary: Oracle-reading test lacked the cache_gen convention's presence guard, so its own self-check ('this gate proved nothing') fired for real in CI instead of being prevented by an early skip
